statement_en: Define the arithmetic function $$P_{\alpha}(n)=\sum_{d|n} \sin(2\pi d\alpha),$$ where $\alpha\not\in \mathbb{Z}$. Find the limit $$\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n\leq N} P_{\alpha}(n).$$
key_techniques: mean value theorem for arithmetic functions
callout_body: 定义算术函数$$P_{\alpha}(n)=\sum_{d|n} \sin(2\pi d\alpha)$$其中$\alpha\not \in \mathbb{Z}$。求极限$$\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n\leq N} P_{\alpha}(n)$$
